note: Industry-recognized accreditation and certification paths relevant to a private Islamic/Arabic school — statuses are the school's own tracking: accredited | pursuing | researching | placeholder. Verify each body's current requirements on their site; descriptions are classroom-level summaries.
intro: Recognized accreditations and certifications the academy holds, is pursuing, or is evaluating.

tracks.desc: The most widely recognized K–12 accreditor in the US South — used by many Texas private and Islamic schools; reviews governance, curriculum, and continuous improvement.

tracks.org: TEPSAC — Texas Private School Accreditation Commission
tracks.desc: The umbrella recognized by the state of Texas: accreditation through a TEPSAC-approved body gives credits and transcripts standing with Texas public schools.

tracks.org: CISNA — Council of Islamic Schools in North America
tracks.desc: Accredits full-time Islamic schools on both academic standards and Islamic environment; commonly paired with Cognia.
The standard scale (Novice → Superior) for rating speaking and comprehension — teacher OPI certification and student ratings align our Arabic levels with a recognized scale.
A standardized Arabic proficiency test offered internationally; a recognized certificate target for advanced students.
The traditional chain-certified license in recitation/memorization granted by a qualified sheikh — the gold standard credential for hifz students and Quran teachers.
National Association for the Education of Young Children — the recognized early-childhood program accreditation.
